Following the planning , the execution agent generates programs to execute tools and calibrates the incorrect result with the review of review agent . An example to illustrate the proposed adaptive agent communication in our framework ConAgents. The agent flow mainly alternates from (1) generating tool-use planning by grounding agent and (2) generating execution code by execution agent, in a step-by-step manner. The review agent is adaptively triggered to provide feedback only when the generated code fails to execute correctly . In this figure, we highlight the review of review agent with red .
